{"id":2048406382,"question_id":3724,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1782615387,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"167 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2048406382/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Filter Occupied Intervals","memory":"214.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<vector<int>> filterOccupiedIntervals(vector<vector<int>>& occupiedIntervals, int freeStart, int freeEnd) {\n        sort(begin(occupiedIntervals) , end(occupiedIntervals));\n\n        vector<vector<int>>ans;\n        vector<vector<int>>merged;\n\n        for(auto it : occupiedIntervals){\n            if(merged.empty() or merged.back()[1]+1 < it[0]) merged.push_back(it);\n            else merged.back()[1] = max(merged.back()[1] , it[1]);\n        }\n\n        for(auto it : merged){\n            int st = it[0];\n            int end = it[1];\n            if(st > freeEnd or end < freeStart) ans.push_back({st , end});\n            else \n            {\n                if(st < freeStart) ans.push_back({st , freeStart - 1});\n                if(end > freeEnd) ans.push_back({freeEnd + 1 , end});\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"filter-occupied-intervals","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2247}
